units.source_text: 此诗故意模仿来诗，用许多地名，也本末不称，寓讥笑之意。

en.t: This poem deliberately imitates the poem that came before it, using many place names; it is also inconsistent from beginning to end, and carries a mocking intent.

units.source_text: 大意是：“请你早点来，我在等候你。”

en.t: Its general meaning is: Please come soon; I am waiting for you.

units.source_text: 日文“待”与“松”同音，箱崎地方松树有名，故末句云云。

en.t: In Japanese, wait and pine tree have the same sound, and the Hakozaki area is famous for its pine trees; that is why the final line says what it does.
